Celebrations

Stuffed eggs

Töltött tojás

8 months+ Adjusted 20 min 4 portions

From 8 months, in small pieces, with the child seated. If egg or milk is new, try the first taste in the morning on a well day.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 2 eggs (hard-boiled until the yolk is firm)
  • 2 tbsp plain pasteurized yogurt (unsweetened; replaces raw mayonnaise)
  • 1/4 tsp sweet paprika (mild; not hot paprika and not salt)

Allergens

milkegg

Method

  1. Boil the eggs for 10 minutes so the yolks are firm, then cool them in cold water.
  2. Peel the eggs, halve them, and lift out the yolks.
  3. Mash the yolks with yogurt and sweet paprika, adding no salt.
  4. Spoon the yolk back into the whites.
  5. Cut pieces small enough for the child.

Adjusted

Raw mayonnaise and salt are the usual filling, and a whole half-egg is large for a child.

Halve hard-boiled eggs and mash the yolks with plain yogurt and sweet paprika, with no raw mayonnaise and no salt. Cut pieces small enough for the child.
